title: clinical/insurance_policies
description: One row per insurance policy held by one patient. Health insurance cover. Roughly 90% of patients hold exactly one policy and the remainder hold none, so this table is a natural test case for LEFT JOIN behaviour and for code that assumes every patient is insured.

patient_id.description: The patient this policy covers. Unique, because in this dataset a patient holds at most one policy.

provider.description: Insurer name. All eight are invented companies; none corresponds to a real insurance business.

policy_number.description: The insurer's reference for this policy, as it would be quoted on a claim.

coverage_level.description: Tier of cover, from Basic to Comprehensive. Weighted towards the cheaper tiers, as real policy mixes are.

annual_premium.description: What the policy costs per year. Correlates with coverage level and with the patient's age, so a scatter plot of premium against age slopes upward.

valid_from.description: Date cover began. Always on or after the start of the dataset period, 2023-01-01.

valid_until.description: Date cover expires. Always after valid_from, typically by one to three years.
